Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + next steps so we can scope pricing accurately: 

Summary of what I heard on the call:
- Primary product: user-facing chat + background retrieval for support articles (mixed short/long outputs).
- Typical convo: short prompts (~400–600 tokens) with medium completions (~700–1,500 tokens) for support replies.
- Heavy tail: ~5% of sessions attach/stream in long-context documents (case histories, long KB docs) that require >32k context. A small set (~0.2%) require near-128k for bulk exports/analysis.
- Monthly volume: you estimated ~40–70M tokens/month today with growth to ~150M in Q4 if expansion goes well.

Ask from our side to price accurately: if you can share a quick sample/profile (avg prompt tokens, avg completion tokens, 50/90/95p completion lengths, percent of requests hitting 8k/32k/128k), that helps us give concrete $/1M token guidance and model choices.

Attached I’ve included a sample CSV template (acme_token_profile.csv) you can drop numbers into. If easier, reply with the three key numbers below and we’ll run an initial cost sketch: 
- avg_prompt_tokens
- avg_completion_tokens
- % requests needing >8k, >32k, >128k

Timeline/next steps:
- You fill the CSV or reply with the three numbers — we’ll produce a unit-cost estimate and two model/config recommendations (latency-optimized + cost-optimized) within 48 hours.
- If the numbers look good, Jordan (SE) can run a short perf sketch on a representative prompt set.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

Perfect — this is exactly what we need, thanks for the numbers. Quick sketch from our side to align expectations on unit economics (ballpark) and options: 

High-level pricing sketches (per 1M tokens, total cost to you including model + infra):
- 8k context-class (latency-optimized): $28–$36 / 1M tokens — recommended for interactive support. (8k model, optimized batching & caching)
- 32k context-class (cost-optimized variant): $35–$50 / 1M tokens — for sessions where we keep full document context in memory (tradeoff: higher mem and token cost)
- 128k context-class (specialized / batch): $70–$110 / 1M tokens — only route rare export/analysis jobs here or use a dedicated batch pipeline with different pricing

Notes/assumptions:
- These ranges assume ~55M–150M monthly tokens and a mix of hosted + reserved dedicated capacity for steady load. Final price depends on commitment (reserved capacity discounts), model selection (open quantized vs larger fp16 variants), and routing policy for heavy-tail jobs.
- For your budget target of $30–$45 / 1M: the 8k latency-optimized option fits well; 32k will be toward the high end unless we can compress context (retrieval + document chunking).

Proposed next steps:
1) Jordan to run a quick perf sketch on a representative sample (we’ll use the CSV if you send it) — checks latency, token counts, and memory.
2) I’ll put together a short cost comparison doc (SOW-draft.pdf attached) showing expected monthly spend at 55M / 100M / 150M token tiers.
3) If the perf + cost are acceptable, we can do a 30-day pilot on Dedicated capacity to lock in an SLA and commit pricing.

We attached the CSV template and a draft SOW for internal review. Happy to set a 30-minute follow-up next week — Jordan, any time windows?

Thanks,
Marissa
